description: Owning handles and the partial-initialization frontier

expected.contract: Lengths[1,2,3] with failure on take2 produce NOMEM, one release, zero live blocks and unchanged empty output. Failure on take1 releases nothing. Three successful takes publish count3; two destroy calls together perform exactly three releases. A zero middle count causes no allocator invocation.

verification_method: Independent state/set oracle recomputes cases.json; prose and changed conditions are assessed separately.
